name: medium-capacity
description: 512 MiB single-file / 2 GiB task profile; storage backend is independent (named volumes or POSIX binds)
notes: Per-file complete AV remains mandatory; no sampling or early admission.
Wall, CPU and total-scan limits follow the fixed gb envelope in deploy/security-scanner/scanner.py; only the per-file and task limits are tightened.
Storage is not part of this profile: named volumes work everywhere, POSIX binds require the native probe.
A 256 MiB input is 50 percent of the per-file cap so descriptor and hash copies stay inside one staging quota.
